name: You Can't Defeat Me
look: Three stacked stills from Thor: Ragnarok. Top: Cate Blanchett as Hela, in a black antler headdress, says You can't defeat me. Middle: Chris Hemsworth as Thor, under a stormy sky, replies I know, but he can. Bottom: the city of Asgard explodes in flames.
use: Someone can't beat a problem themselves, so they unleash something bigger that can. Hela is the opponent, Thor is you, and the exploding city shows the overkill solution doing the job, often wrecking everything along with it.
slots: label on Hela: the unbeatable problem
label on Thor: the one who can't win
label on the explosion: the bigger force that can
examples: A tiny spider in the bathroom
An entire can of bug spray
